name: Anime Expo
organizer: Society for the Promotion of Japanese Animation (SPJA)
blurb: The largest celebration of Japanese pop culture in North America, held over July 4th weekend at the LA Convention Center.

editions.evidence: Homepage banner and meta description: 'Anime Expo July 2-5, 2027 Los Angeles Convention Center Coming Soon!' / 'Join us in downtown Los Angeles on July 2-5, 2027!'. The page's JSON-LD event is stale (still dated 'Anime Expo 2026'); the visible text and a July 10, 2026 press release confirming AX 2026 'wraps its 35th edition' were trusted instead.

notes: No dedicated 'all guests' roster page exists yet; the site's Guest blog category's newest post is from June 18, 2026 (about the 2026 show) with nothing posted yet for 2027, so guests is 'none-yet' rather than 'announced'.
